answer: Measure trust as max-flow from the honest seed set, not vouch count. By Menger's theorem the edge-disjoint trust paths reaching an identity equal the min cut separating it from the seeds — so a sybil cluster behind a thin neck of attack edges admits only that few paths, however densely its fakes vouch among themselves. Extra internal links, bright as a comet yet weightless, add no disjoint path across the sparse umber boundary. Honest nodes sit where many independent ferrous-strong paths converge; standing is capped by the cut, so bulk fakes split one trickle of flow.
